answers.says: The New York Times has told its photographers not to install the new Photoshop update.
Final Cut Pro can now make subtitles for your videos in 23 more languages.
Logic on the iPad can now pull the drums out of a song and put each drum on its own track.
If you wrote and published your own book, Spotify will make it into an audiobook for free.
Google tried to patent an AI TV channel where every show stars you, and the patent office turned it down.
A meme: the AI music company is laughing and excited about its big plan, while the songwriter who read the small print in the contract is not smiling at all.
A meme: a film director celebrating because he pulled off the shot an AI storyboard said could not be done.
A meme: the AI needs 400 tries to make a perfect piece of music, and the human musician does it just as well in one go.
A meme: the real, human-made mix turns up at the very last second, just before the label gives up and uses the AI one.
Figma can now make six AI pictures from one request so you can pick one.
Roblox's AI helper can watch a recording of your game being played, spot what is broken and fix it.
Runway can now cut a person out of a video and put them on a new background without a green screen.
People used chatbots to give a cheap $70 synth new features, and the company that makes it let them.
An AI-made poster showed a huge Christmas market, but people turned up to a nearly empty hall with five stalls and buckets.
A meme: a video editor going wild with joy because the client liked the cut and did not ask for an AI version.
A meme: a hand-drawn cartoon getting uploaded to a film festival just seconds before the deadline, like a last-second winning score.
A meme: loads of AI video tools all piling in to try and win the same short advert job.
A meme: walking into the studio with all the real musicians whose playing the AI music tool learned from.
A meme: after seeing one AI demo, game companies want to remake their fantasy game set in every decade.
